  "pros": [
    "Comprehensive feature set for managing customer relationships.",
    "Good value for money compared to alternatives like HubSpot.",
    "Customization options allow for tailoring to specific workflows."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Reporting tools can lack the comprehensiveness needed for detailed analysis.",
    "The user interface can sometimes feel overwhelming due to its extensive features.",
    "Adapting the system to unique sales or customer success pipelines can be challenging."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Customer Success Manager likely found Zoho CRM to be a capable and cost-effective solution for managing customer relationships in their education management company. While appreciating its customization and overall functionality, they probably encountered some frustrations with the depth of its reporting and the initial complexity of the interface, especially when coming from HubSpot. However, the perceived value for money kept them satisfied with the product over their 1-2 years of use."
